hud.xaeronav.unreachable_blocked_detour: No way through from here — try approaching from another direction

hud.xaeronav.unreachable_unmapped: The map shows no connection to the destination — the area around it may still be unexplored
hud.xaeronav.unreachable_limits: No way through within your limits (bridges, swimming, falls, jumps, block count) — turn off "Strict limits" to also search past them

gui.xaeronav.config.title: XaeroNav Settings
gui.xaeronav.config.auto_walk_on_servers: Many servers treat automated movement as cheating. Only turn this on where the server rules allow it.
gui.xaeronav.config.auto_walk_stop_healt: Auto-walk stops once your health drops to this or below.
gui.xaeronav.config.route_profile.balanc: The default trade-off between travel time and risk.
gui.xaeronav.config.route_profile.fastes: Shortest travel time. Jumps, fall damage, edges and drops weigh half as much, so routes pass closer to danger.
gui.xaeronav.config.route_profile.safest: Avoids risk even if the route gets longer. Never takes fall damage and avoids risky jumps, whatever those settings say.
gui.xaeronav.config.route_profile.resour: Places and breaks as few blocks as possible and walks around obstacles instead.
gui.xaeronav.config.boats_enabled: Allow boats in routes (when you carry one)
gui.xaeronav.config.digging_enabled.tool: Off it will break blocks you did not place, including builds and terrain, to shorten a route.
gui.xaeronav.config.bridging_enabled: Allow block placement (bridging, pillaring) in routes
gui.xaeronav.config.bridging_enabled.too: On it spends blocks from your inventory to cross gaps and climb cliffs.
gui.xaeronav.config.lava_bridging_enable: Cross lava by placing blocks (last resort)
On you may be told to place blocks directly over lava; missing a placement there is fatal.
gui.xaeronav.config.deep_look_ahead_enab: Keep extending the route ahead while walking
gui.xaeronav.config.jump_gap_enabled: Allow jumping gaps (up to 3 blocks) in routes
gui.xaeronav.config.block_budget_enabled: Limit placements to the blocks you carry
gui.xaeronav.config.fall_damage_toleranc: On some routes will drop you from heights that hurt, up to a third of your health.
gui.xaeronav.config.strict_limits.toolti: On: never route over long bridges, swims you can't hold your breath for, jumps over the void, or more blocks than you carry, even when there is no other way. Off: such routes are shown with a warning, only when there is no other way.
gui.xaeronav.config.flight_routing_enabl: Route through the air while gliding
gui.xaeronav.config.flight_clearance: Prefer open space over tight gaps
gui.xaeronav.config.straight_line_enable: Show dotted line for unsearched sections
gui.xaeronav.config.goal_marker_enabled: Pin the destination on Xaero's maps
gui.xaeronav.config.danger_dashed_enable: Dash dangerous sections of the line
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.on: XaeroNav: auto-walk on (move or turn to take over)
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.on_server: XaeroNav: auto-walk on. Many servers treat automated movement as cheating; only use it where the rules allow it
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.singleplayer_only: XaeroNav: auto-walk only runs in singleplayer. Many servers treat automated movement as cheating; enable autoWalk.allowOnServers in the config only where the rules allow it
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.no_route: XaeroNav: set a destination before starting auto-walk
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.route_ended: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped, the route was cleared
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.manual_step: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped, the next step needs you (digging, launching a boat, or flying)
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.danger: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped before a dangerous section (lava, void, fall damage or drowning)
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.player_input: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped, you took over
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.hurt: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped, you took damage
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.low_health: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped, health is low
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.shore: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped at the shore; get out and pick up your boat
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.unsupported_vehicl: XaeroNav: auto-walk can only steer you on foot or in a boat
hud.xaeronav.autowalk.no_walkable_route: XaeroNav: auto-walk stopped, there is no route without swimming, building or jumps

commands.xaeronav.mapdata_requested: requested loading of %d region(s) — run again in a moment
commands.xaeronav.mapdata_here: here: %1$s, map height %2$d (actual Y %3$d, floors at this cell %4$d)

commands.xaeronav.route_too_far: XaeroNav: destination is too far (exceeds the diagnostic command's range limit)
commands.xaeronav.route_none: XaeroNav: no route found (computed in %d ms)
commands.xaeronav.route_same_chunk: XaeroNav: destination is in the same chunk as you (no waypoints)
commands.xaeronav.route_summary_reached: XaeroNav long-range route: %1$d waypoint(s), reached destination, computed in %2$d ms
commands.xaeronav.route_summary_partial: XaeroNav long-range route: %1$d waypoint(s), did not reach destination (stopped at the closest point), computed in %2$d ms
commands.xaeronav.corridor_no_data: leg %1$d/%2$d: no map data for this segment (checked in %3$d ms, %4$d region(s) not yet loaded)
commands.xaeronav.corridor_leg_reached: leg %1$d/%2$d: reached (%3$d steps, %4$d ms, %5$d region(s) not yet loaded)
commands.xaeronav.corridor_leg_partial: leg %1$d/%2$d: did not reach (%3$d steps, %4$d ms, %5$d region(s) not yet loaded)
commands.xaeronav.probe_goal_ok: goal cell: reachable (ground below=OK, feet=%1$s, head=%2$s)
commands.xaeronav.probe_goal_outside_bou: * the goal lies outside the search area box (%s blocks away; the box is clipped at the render distance of %s blocks); this search can never reach it
commands.xaeronav.probe_goal_blocked: * cannot stand at the goal cell (ground below=%1$s, feet=%2$s, head=%3$s). Arrival requires an exact coordinate match, so this search can never reach it
commands.xaeronav.probe_no_digging_skipp: -> digging is disabled in the config, so the digging-off comparison is skipped
commands.xaeronav.probe_summary_reached: XaeroNav detail search (%1$s): reached (%2$d steps, %3$d nodes expanded, %7$d distinct cells, %4$d ms, search area %5$d×%6$d blocks)
commands.xaeronav.probe_summary_partial: XaeroNav detail search (%1$s): did not reach (%2$d steps, %3$d nodes expanded, %7$d distinct cells, %4$d ms, search area %5$d×%6$d blocks)
commands.xaeronav.probe_workload: workload: placed %1$d, dug %2$d cells, up %3$d / down %4$d (net %5$d)
commands.xaeronav.probe_placing_on: placing: available (caps bridge %1$d / lava %2$d / void %3$d blocks, %4$d per route, 0 = unlimited)
commands.xaeronav.probe_placing_off: * placing: unavailable (%s). No bridge or pillar moves are generated at all
commands.xaeronav.probe_placing_no_block: no placeable block in the inventory
commands.xaeronav.probe_placing_disabled: bridgingEnabled is off in the config
commands.xaeronav.probe_trimmed: * dropped %1$d trailing placement(s) (a bridge was built but never reached the far side; the "placed" count above excludes them)
commands.xaeronav.probe_bridge_cap_block: * bridge moves were discarded by the run cap (bridge %1$d / lava %2$d / void %3$d blocks). Live navigation loosens the caps and retries when it proves there is no way through; this probe measures a single pass
commands.xaeronav.probe_chunks_missing: * only %1$d of %2$d chunks in the search area are loaded (missing chunks are treated as impassable)
commands.xaeronav.probe_widen_triggered: -> did not reach within the normal margin, retrying with the search area widened to the render distance
commands.xaeronav.probe_widen_skipped: -> widened retry condition not met (already reached, or destination is outside the render distance)
commands.xaeronav.probe_widen_skipped_bu: -> did not reach because the node budget (%1$d) was exhausted. Widening the search area would hit the same cap, so no retry is attempted (try raising heuristicWeight or maxExpandedNodes)
